trivia: Prior to 'Enter SM64', agent z 100%'d their save file on Super Mario 64 from Super Mario 3D All-Stars. Before, it had just been completed at 70 stars.
The 'agent z in 2025' retrospective features Minecraft gameplay, being the first instance for agent z of background gameplay footage not being from Splatoon 3.

The thumbnail for 'The Perfect Present' was made far in advance prior to any delays. This was so agent z didn't need to render a thumbnail while overseas as their laptop would struggle with running Garry's Mod.
The font size for dialogue was first shrunk in the episode 'Agent's Infiltrating Mission', the first episode for 2024.
Agent X first appeared in a Splatshort with 'Agent Z doesn't get the joke', taking 15 Splatshorts to appear.
While titled similarly, 'agent z Versus' is not an intentional reference to 'Nintendo Versus', official branding for Nintendo's competitive tournaments.
An inkling-modified voice is used in the place of Agent Z for promotional segments, but is yet to be officially used within any episodes.

The Inkopolis Square tower, the 'Deca Tower', is used in 3 seperate thumbnails, being for 'Clash of the Agents', 'Battle of Inkopolis Square', and the Announcement Trailer for the Power Trip Story Arc's finale.
Agent 3 with sunglasses in the thumbnail for 'Beach Episode' intentionally parallels with a teaser render that had featured Neo Agent 3 with sunglasses.

The special event for 10,000 subscribers was originally planned to be a competition relative to Nintendo video games. It was changed to be the agent z Art Contest for accessibility to ensure as many people as possible could participate.
The purple with the hex code '7B01FA' is the 'official purple color' for the agent z YouTube Channel. It is taken from Agent Z's icon's hair color.
Agent Z being bad at the guitar as seen in the Splatshort 'Agent Z's Guitar Solo' parallels with Agent X being good at the guitar and playing it since her childhood.

Each year featured one Splatshort dedicated to a joke being unfunny, with these Splatshorts always being the last ones to appear in each year's respective Splatshort compilation. All three play at the end of the complete Splatshort compilation (2023-2025).
The agent z icon in thumbnails never appears at the bottom right as the timestamp for the video would block it.
The agent z Art Contest Discord Server's final member count before the server officially shut down invites was 281 members, excluding bots.

The thumbnail for 'The Countdown' parallels with the thumbnail for 'Fireworks Festival', with Neo Agent 3 appearing in the left for the former and Agent 3 and Agent 8 appearing in the right for the latter and both featuring fireworks.

Bonus: flattered that you're interested enough to go looking in the code (:
